description: LSTM-based deep learning model for classifying short text into one of 6 emotions.

input.description: Raw or lightly cleaned text. The saved model contains a TextVectorization layer, so raw text can be passed directly.
input.example: i am feeling really anxious about tomorrow

output.description: Softmax probability distribution over the 6 emotion classes. Predicted class is the index with the highest probability.

preprocessing.note: The TextVectorization layer is embedded in the saved .keras model, so no separate tokenizer file is needed.

inference_example_python:
import tensorflow as tf
model = tf.keras.models.load_model('src/models/deep_learning/lstm_model.keras')
probs = model(tf.constant(['i am feeling really anxious about tomorrow'])).numpy()
predicted_class = probs.argmax(axis=1)[0]
notes: The saved model already contains the TextVectorization layer.
The deployment code can load lstm_model.keras directly.
Confirm the TensorFlow/Keras version in the deployment environment if a model loading error occurs.
Performance values correspond to the latest test run recorded for this model.
